vibe_rationale: Deep community and multi-format culture across a six-day camping festival with a values-led, welcoming tone, though large and broad rather than a curated subculture.
fit_notes: Mixed all-ages crowd with strong wellbeing and environmental values and 70 per cent repeat visitors, so the all-ages mix dilutes adult targeting. Wellbeing sits naturally in this community, but partners must fit its non-profit ethos, and the media inbox is the only partner contact on record.
